headline: 最後一次家庭遊戲之夜
context: 英國作家 Dominik Diamond 寫下與家人相處20年的最後一次遊戲之夜，回顧電動遊戲如何把這個歷經風雨的家庭一次次拉在一起。另外，瑪麗蓮夢露百歲冥誕前夕，也有人發現她與影星達科塔強森其實是遠房親戚。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: I wanted our last family games night to be the best fun we’ve ever had. Maybe we should have stuck with Mario Kart … It is the end of an era for the Diamond family. For 20 years, there have been five of us living together. It has not been easy. Militant vegan daughters, sons who have inherited Scottish tempers, and a youngest child who attracts trouble like an industrial magnet, have meant our house has been conflict-laden at times. Throw in the fact that we are beset with all manner of mental health bobbins and chronic illnesses that resulted in two of our three kids almost dying in hospitals and you get a family that is combustible – but extremely close. Through it all, we had games. They always brought us back together. Not just us all hunkering over Super Mario Kart like some kind of UN-mandated family therapy, but the conversations that happen when any of us spy another playing something new. Games are a cultural touchstone that helped us crack through the veneer of disagreements and distrust and remind us that we have more things in common than we sometimes feel. Continue reading...
sources.title: My family is coming apart – so it’s time for one last video game session | Dominik Diamond

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The vogue for celebrity ancestors can be traced back to Robert Pattinson descending from Dracula and Benedict Cumberbatch being related to just about everyone To mark Marilyn Monroe’s 100th birthday, a short film will premiere at this year’s Venice film festival. Entitled Flesh Impact, the film has been written and directed by Maggie Gyllenhaal, and will star two versions of Monroe. The first, played by Ellen Burstyn, will apparently be “a version of Monroe the world never got to see”, while Dakota Johnson will play Monroe in her pomp. Ahead of its premiere, a photo of Johnson dolled up as Monroe has been released. And it has to be said that the resemblance is actually pretty good. This could be down to one of two reasons. The first is that Monroe is so iconic that you could slap a wig and a beauty spot on Phil Mitchell and you’d immediately see who he was trying to emulate. Or it could be because Marilyn Monroe and Dakota Johnson are literally related. Continue reading...

thread_text:
最後一次家庭遊戲之夜

英國作家 Dominik Diamond 寫下一篇長文，回顧一家五口相處20年的最後一次電玩遊戲之夜——這個家庭經歷過重病、衝突與磨難，是電動遊戲一次次把大家拉回同一張沙發。另外，瑪麗蓮夢露（Marilyn Monroe）百歲冥誕前夕，有人發現她和影星達科塔強森（Dakota Johnson）竟是遠房表親，兩人的扮相對照照片也在網路上流傳。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 31 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
最後一次家庭遊戲之夜

英國作家 Dominik Diamond 寫下一篇長文，回顧一家五口相處20年的最後一次電玩遊戲之夜。這個家庭經歷過重病、衝突與磨難，他說，是電動遊戲一次次把大家拉回同一張沙發前。

另一則輕鬆一點的消息：瑪麗蓮夢露（Marilyn Monroe）即將迎來百歲冥誕，有人發現她和影星達科塔強森（Dakota Johnson）竟是遠房表親，兩人的扮相對照照片也在網路上流傳開來。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 31 日發佈。
voice_text: 一家五口，一起玩了20年遊戲，這是他們最後一次遊戲之夜。這個家庭經歷過重病、衝突，磨難不少，但作者說，每次吵得不可開交，電動遊戲總能把大家重新拉回同一張沙發。換個輕鬆的話題——瑪麗蓮夢露快滿一百歲了。有人發現，她和影星達科塔強森竟然是遠房表親，兩人的扮相放在一起，還真有點像。
